summitMcp.probeTarget.description: Which HTTP host Diagnose, CRUD, and /health use. auto uses the hosting URL when set.

summitMcp.remoteUrl.description: Public hosting URL (Render or any HTTPS host). No trailing slash. Written as mcp-ticket-demo-remote.

summitMcp.codeEngineUrl.markdownDescription: IBM Code Engine origin, no path (empty until you paste your deployed URL). **Connect Code Engine** writes `mcp-ticket-demo-codeengine` (`/mcp` and `/sse`) and points Diagnose/CRUD at it. This host is separate from `summitMcp.remoteUrl`.

summitMcp.podmanImage.description: Local Podman image name built from mcp-ticket-demo/Dockerfile.

summitMcp.adminPassword.description: Admin password for /admin. Do not use this default in production.

summitMcp.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key to present when calling tools. Issue one on `/admin` → API keys. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` over HTTP, and as `MCP_API_KEY` to a stdio or Podman server.

summitMcp.authMode.markdownDescription: Auth mode the local server boots with: `off` (nothing gated), `write` (write and PII tools need a credential), `all` (every tool call does).

summitMcp.corsOrigins.markdownDescription: Web-page origins allowed to call the HTTP server from a browser, comma-separated (for example `https://app.example.com`). Passed as `CORS_ORIGINS` when this extension starts the native HTTP server or the container; restart it to apply. Localhost and the server's own host are always allowed. A deployed server needs the same variable in its own environment.

summitMcp.autoConnectStdio.markdownDescription: On activate, write native stdio (`mcp-ticket-demo`) into `.vscode/mcp.json` and the other IDE configs if it is missing. Never overwrites an HTTP/SSE entry. Turn off to manage `mcp.json` yourself.

summitMcp.showBrowserTab.description: Show the Browser tab (browser access and CORS test) and its tree and menu entries. Hidden by default. Running a command that needs the tab turns this on.

summitMcp.showRemoteConfigTab.description: Show the Remote config tab (demo setup, rate limit, users, API keys, any tool) and its tree and menu entries. Hidden by default. Running its command turns this on.

summitMcp.showEventsTab.description: Show the Events tab (listen live, MQTT, logging level) and its tree and menu entries. Hidden by default. Running its command turns this on.
